goal: Issue #455 (Spec docs/specs/review-config-invalid.spec.md, D1-D7). Review preparation reports an invalid user agents table as review_config_invalid naming the file and key path, warns on review_ready when it runs on the legacy lanes fallback, and its recovery texts name agents.profiles/agents.presets instead of lanes.review_host; drive.md and the config reference follow. Execution posture: test-first on tests/cli-review-dispatch.test.ts.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/cli-review-dispatch.test.ts, a user agents table whose only code-review profile has host "codex" and no project lanes makes coordinator.advance return review_preparation_failed with code review_config_invalid, a reason naming the user config file and agents.profiles.review.host, and a recovery_action naming agents.profiles.review.host and advance_assurance, with QA settlement retained; the same table with a valid host returns review_ready (Spec D1, BR-SCN-1).

In tests/cli-review-dispatch.test.ts, the same invalid agents table plus project lanes.review_host pi makes coordinator.advance return review_ready on host pi with exactly one warnings entry of code review_legacy_profile whose message names lanes and agents; a valid agents table and a legacy-only config each return review_ready without warnings (Spec D4, BR-SCN-2).

In tests/cli-review-dispatch.test.ts, a config with no review profile still returns review_profile_required, and both its recovery_action and the review_host_unavailable recovery_action contain agents.profiles and do not contain lanes.review_host (Spec D2, D3).

plugins/immune-brain/dist/drive.md and docs/reference/immune-brain-config.md both name review_config_invalid, and the dist mirror of the config reference stays byte-identical per bun scripts/sync-dist-docs.ts --check (Spec D6).
bun run typecheck passes over the whole repository, so the widened ReviewPreparationError code union and the optional warnings fields are consistent for every Host (Spec section 3).
